text: This day is observed to face what feels stuck in your life, with Ganapati as the one who clears the way.
It is about starting, not about waiting for things to change on their own.
Today, you might like to chant 'Om Gam Ganapataye Namaha'.
You can offer some durva grass and a little jaggery to Ganapati.
If it suits your home, you can also do the evening pooja after moonrise.
Think of one thing you have been putting off, and take the first small step on it today.
